text: I think you'll really enjoy this Whole Wheat Yeast Free Herbed Pizza Dough recipe. As a vegetarian, you'll appreciate that it's free from animal products, and the use of whole wheat flour and cornmeal adds a nutritious twist. The fact that it's yeast-free also makes it a great option for those who are sensitive to yeast or prefer a simpler recipe. Plus, the herbed flavor will add a delicious twist to your pizza without overpowering the other ingredients. It's also quick to make, ready in about 30 minutes, which fits within your time budget.
